description: Search curated Pinterest moodboards and collections by topic or aesthetic (e.g. "mid century interior", "bridal editorial") with pin counts, cover images, sample thumbnails, color swatches, and creator handles. Cost: 2 Credits / board returned (0 Credits if empty).

query.description: Moodboard or aesthetic search query, e.g. "mid century interior".

name: boards_search

boards.description: Normalized board objects with board ID, title, pin count, cover thumbnails, dominant color swatches, and creator handle.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of boards.

meta.description: Request telemetry, credit billing, and cache status metadata.

cached.description: Whether the response was served from warm cache.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on cache-empty or error).

took_ms.description: End-to-end server processing latency in milliseconds.

title: Search Pinterest Creator Boards & Moodboards
